chapters.title: NEW DEMAND ZONE
chapters.text: Three bullish bars in a row on at least average volume: the tool draws a demand zone 26,464.25–26,473.00 on the last bearish candle before the move. Action edge 26,473.00.

chapters.title: DEMAND DEFENDED
chapters.text: Price trades into the demand zone at 26,473.00 and closes back above it, short of the far edge 26,464.25: a filled diamond, and the zone's conviction rises. Aggressive selling was 52% of the volume inside the zone on this bar.

chapters.title: DEMAND DEFENDED 2×
chapters.text: The second return to the demand zone: price closes back above it, short of the far edge 26,464.25, and another filled diamond prints. Aggressive selling was 72% of the volume inside the zone on this bar.
